nom: Buttah Skin Tea Tree Exfoliating Scrub

avis.texte: Works just as supposed too! Love how my skin feels after so soft and subtle with that Melanin glow! Thank you Buttah Fam!!
This feels so nice and cooling on the skin and has a decent scrub to it. I personally like a more in 106 exfoliator but this one feels nice and soothing.

avis.titre: Yes, I would buy this again
avis.texte: This is a game changer for someone who suffer with pimples all the skin and just want to get a deep clean use this and it's great for closing pores.
this is by far one of the best physical scrub formulas ive ever used. highly recommend!!

avis.titre: Esthetician says my skin is in great shape
avis.texte: Great cleanser. I use it on my face when I'm taking a shower so I can leave it on a little longer than the regular cleanser.
Oh my goodness...This Tea Tree Scrub is awesome! It smells wonderful and has my skin tingling! My face looks and feels great after each use.

I love the way this product is used. After I shower & cleanse my face with the gentle cleanser I put on the mask/scrub. It feels great on my face after my morning walk. I only use it once a week since I have sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Definitely will buy again and again
avis.texte: Best face scrub ever. It's light and no abrasive. Leaves my skin feel soft and refreshed. This is a staple to my face routine. Love this product and definitely will have the on auto subscribe.!!!!!!!
I use this scrub 2 times a week and it helps with any blemishes or small pimples I may have. It smells good and is not too abrasive.
When I tell this skin is skinning!! This mask really softened my skin and has it glowing. The smell is amazing im obsessed and this is now a staple in my routine.

My skin has never felt so smooth after one use of this product. I have naturally have oily skin, but I have dry patches around my mouth and chin area due to wearing a mask. So I believe I've found the perfect product for those concerns. I recommend this product for the melanin ladies, but please do research on what's best for YOUR skin's needs.
Sooo thankful for this. I use it more than twice per week, as it just keeps my skin so clean, and it has started to help clear my skin so much already.

My first time using this mask left my skin feeling clean and looking supple and hydrated. The Tea Tree Oil smell is not overhelming and the cooling/tingling sensation is relaxing. I put this on as a mask for 5 mins and was impressed at the lather of this product! I love this face mask and am looking forward to trying other products from this brand!

avis.titre: Live tea tree exfoliate by Buttah
avis.texte: Refreshing exfoliating cleans. Love using all Buttah products.
I absolutely love this product. From the daily cleanser to the buttah moisture; it is what you said it would be. Definitely will continue purchasing and using this product.
This feels so good and it is pulling out impurities that are deep down in my pores. Love this for my skin!

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel so clean and refreshed!
avis.texte: This scrub is amazing. My skin always feels so soft and clean afterwards. It helps acne too. 100% reccommend!

I really enjoy using the tea tree & aloe exfoliating it leaves my face feel really nice and clean. I love how it tingle a little bit and i have a nice little glow when i get done with my twice a week sefl care routine
Oh yes, I love this too!!! Definitely going to be in rotation!!!

One word…AMAZING! I'm very particular about my skin, always have been, even as a teen. I saw results with my first use of Tea Tree & Aloe Exfoliating Scrub and I am in-love with the results! I went from years of using expensive prescription dermatology treatments to Buttah products, and I have never looked back. Buttah for life, baby!

I have been using the product for a few weeks. It helps to keep my skin clear. Also, I noticed a different in how my skin feels after using it. It has been great to use along with the facial wash. I am adding Buttah products to my regime as my old products run out. This is definitely a product that I will keep as a part of my face washing routine.
This mask leaves my skin feeling so soft. I only use it twice per wwwk.
This tingles in such a good way. It has a nice amount of exfoliation without being aggressive. Also smells nice!

I recieved this product as a free sample from Ulta and omg it works wonders. It does feel really cool and minty on the face at first but after rinsing it off my skin felt so much clean and healthier. I used it to wash my face off at night and i woke up with super soft skin and my imperfections were minimized even my bf noticed !
Excellent for deep cleansing Stripping old dull skin Producing new life to melanated dull looking skin
It had my face burning. I think my skin was too sensitive for it
This product is amazing. I love how it's a 3 in 1. A cleanser, face mask and it exfoliates. That is so perfect. The results are amazing. My skin was so soft afterwards. Will buy again
The best product so far for my hormonal chin ance. I only use 2x weekly as directed and a little goes far for me.

avis.titre: LIKE WOW. The best facial exfoliator !!
avis.texte: I have used many on my face but when I used this product, I was surprised. It felt like sand on my face but I tell you what... it got all that dead skin off my face and my skin felt so clean and refreshing. Yes I am getting another one soon. Don't get the sample. Get the whole bottle.

avis.titre: I would never buy this again.
avis.texte: I broke out, got acne from it and I never had it this bad before. It is a lie, I would never ever recommend this product my whole face burns!
I have combination skin. This works really well for me, smells great, leaves my skin smooth. A favorite product of mine.
Love it! 10/10!! My skin has been feeling so much more hydrated and healthier!

I absolutely love this product. I use it twice a week and I've noticed a definite improvement on my skin. My skin was dull and dry and needed a wake up call. My skin looks and feels great!! No more dry, dull, and boring skin. Will purchase again.
If your a daily makeup person like myself this is our answer it removes all your mind & the dirt it collects during the day I've added this to my nightly routine & my face thanks me & your all too

I am 57 years old and have been using this product since 2020. This is definitely on my favorites. Feels like you're having a spa treatment every time using it!! This continues to be a staple routine for me.
so I got this product as a free sample and so glad I did. I have sensitive allergy prone skin and this product was so gentle yet cleansing. I'll be buying the full size.

after a few months of using this, the tube literally cracked open on the sides. after a decade of using skincare this has never happened. its not even an everyday product for me, i will not buy from this brand in the future, waste of money and very cheap packaging.

I'm a pasty white girl covered in dirt 90 percent of the time. This exfoliating scrub is the ONLY thing that has worked for me. I use it every day as a general face wash and not as a mask or anything. It is amazing! Worth every penny.

I use this twice a week, along with the 4pc cleansing buttah kit (which I use 1-2 times a day) this product removes all blemishes and evens my skin tone. & it makes my skin feel moisturized without the shine.

avis.titre: Wanted to like this but it broke me out twice.
avis.texte: Really wanted to like this product as I have the moisturizer from this company, but it broke me out twice. The first time I tried it, felt a slight burning sensation but thought it was the tea trea oil working. I had some steak the day before so when I broke out the next day, I figured it was the steak. Decided to give it another go just to make sure and it burned me and broke me out. I have acne hormonal dry skin so just advised for others like me.
Exfoliate! Exfoliate! Exfoliate! My skin feels so soft and clean after using this product

avis.titre: Makes my face bright after use
avis.texte: I absolutely like this product, I use it twice a week. Typically once in the morning on sunday and then once Thursday or Friday. I think the product should provide detail instructions on exactly how many times during the day/week you should use it.
Such a gentle and soothing cleanser! Major game changer in my skin care routine

This is probably my favorite cleanser. It smells good. It feels good. The little exfoliating beads are excellent. At first it feels like clay when its dry, but adding water to activate it, i can feel the change. I feel the product working as I work it in. Very good.
Deep Cleaning Magic for Your Skin. Embrace the Clean feeling sensation.
Brought these items for my grandson to see how he would like them

If I don't use anything else from Buttah Skin, I will forever use this mask! When I tell you, I would get a pimple, use the mask, go to sleep and wake up with them gone *mind blown* I don't know what you use in this but PLEASE don't ever change the formula! 10/10 Highly Recommend
Really enjoying this product! I love the gentle exfoliation especially for my sensitive skin. Noticeably smoother skin
The Best exfoliating scrub on the market. The tea tree oil and aloe leaves my skin feeling clean, hydrated, and literally dirt and grim free.

Gentle exfoliation yet my skin felt clean and hydrated. It didn't feel like it stripped my skins moisture. Seems to help my acne clear faster. Also Love the tingling sensation, feels like it wakes up your pores! Definitely part of my routine 🖤

avis.titre: A mask I don't mind wearing
avis.texte: This mask made my face feel so clean & smoove after using. It really cleans out those pores.

I wanted to try this brand so I purchased the trial kit and when I say I love these products I mean just that. The vitamin E serum is the best! My gave feels and looks so good and fresh after my skincare routine. I plan to purchase the full sized products very soon.

I am a skincare junkie and I think it's hard for me to be impressed. But this product is literally perfect and amazing all around. It's an amazing exfoliant and a great mask. My skin has only improved!

I love this product. I use this as face cleaner in the morning even though this is a face mask. I apply small amount of this product on my dry skin, let it dry amount a couple of minutes and then wet and massage my face and rinse it off. My face is so fresh and clean! No more pimples since I start using this.

avis.titre: Leaves my face feeling slick and slippery
avis.texte: I like the smell and consistency of the product, but it's hard for me to wash off. I don't enjoy face products that leave my face feeling slippery, which is the case here, but overall, a good product.

Love how my skin felt after. It wasn't dry or tight. I used too much when I was trying to create an even, thin layer and that created lots of suds when washing off but that's user error. I really liked the product.
It's nice to replenish my face after working in the elements all day and feel hydrated again.
This is one of my favorite products from your collection!! I love how the exfoliating scrub makes my skin feel! It's like a spa facial in a tube!

This really helps to keep my skin clear. It's a nice exfoliator and helps to unclog pores. At the first sign of a breakout I always use this and, no joke, my pimple will look smaller after using it and be gone in a day when they would last a week or more without this mask. It does smell very stronger of tea tree oil, but I can deal with it. It's cooling on the skin and when you wet it, it suds up nicely, and it isn't too difficult to wash away either. I have a massive amount of skin care products, and this is in my top 3. I first got this product from Ipsy. It's one of my favorite products they've ever sent me, and now I'm here to restock. I think the only time I've ever repurchased something Ipsy had sent me.
Just beginning to use and see the effects on my skin. So far I'm pleased

Love the product itself. The tingle it gives is an amazing sensation. My only issue is the packaging. This is the second time I've purchased this product and the bottle always splits open at the seams and oozes out.
I like that it take the dead skin off then I can moisturize his face

I love how work it give me clear skin next day after put on before bed skin feel smooth nd clean and my top laying skin seem be of my face quality is so good smell is there but I don't mind it tingle don't really feel about I feel more of a tighten after dry
Great face scrub that has a cooling tingling sensation. Definitely recommend.
I think it's a pretty good product. Feels great on your clean. Leaves it smooth and refreshed. This is my second purchase. My husband has used it also.

Haven't been using for more than a month or two but so far so good. I love the tingle sensation when using and the freshness feeling my face gets after using. I'm currently using once a week but I may soon switch to twice a week.

I love Buttah's Tea Tree Oil & Aloe Exfoliating Scrub! Bravo for how smooth & silky my skin feels after use without going through my daily Buttah Regimen Kit. Then I do my regular wash, toner, Vitamin C Serum, & moisturizer. I love my Buttah! My best friend has already ordered her customize set along with this scrub after seeing my skin.
Amazing!! Leaves my face so smooth and it doesn't try me out. My face feels clean and the glow is everything!!! Thank you Dorian for creating awesome products!!
I love how my face feels so smooth after uses this product and the other products by buttah.
Love how it makes my face feel refreshed and cool after using.

I like the consistency and refreshing, light scent. A little goes a long way and I do feel an overall deep cleaning after use. My skin has consistently looked great since use of buttah products. All in all I love my skin and with these products I have found my t-zone less oily (yay) which is impressive during these summer months. My face has a beautiful clear tone and glow.

I have a really sensitive skin and I've been unable to find a scrub that would gently exfoliate without leaving my skin worse than before. This scrub by Buttah is my holy grail. It's amazing. Just everything about it: the smell, how fresh my skin feels, the deeper clean I get without irritating my face is amazing.
Great quality product that makes my face feel amazing after using.
I love this mask. I got it in my ipsy bag and came and bought another tube. It's sooo good!! Thanks Buttah
i loved this cleanser/exfoliating combo. loved the cool feel of the mask after washing it off. left my skin feeling very clean not tight.
The tea tree and aloe mask scrub leaves my skin feeling smooth and refreshed!!! The facial shea butter is nourishing and not greasy!!! Great products!!!
The scrub left my skin feeling soft and smooth after applying. The smell has a nice fragrance to it. The dark spots on my chin is clearing. This is a great product!
Good product!eaves my face feeling refreshed and clean. I try to use this twice a week along with my other facial products.
This exfoliator is tough on dead skin cells but so gentle on your actual skin! This is a must have for me!
I absolutely love this product! It makes my skin feel fresh and rejuvenated. I am definitely purchasing this again!
Really good exfoliate. I feel like a my face goes through a good deep cleaning after using this item.
EVERY PRODUCT IS EXCEPTIONAL. I WILL BE A FAN FOR A LONG TIME
It's not too harsh on the skin, leaves my face feeling fresh an smooth.

Definitely has a cleansing sensation while providing aromatherapy at the same time. It makes my skin feel smooth and soft. A little goes a long way. Love that I can save time using this 2 for 1 product. I would absolutely recommend it.
I absolutely love these products! I've gotten sooo many compliments on my skin after only using them for a week.

I was concerned the first time I put this on because it smelled so strongly of tea tree oil. I was convinced it was going to burn my face. I was so very wrong and it's become one of my favorite products. Its cooling on the skin and gives a nice gentle exfoliation after letting it sit for a few minutes. If you are sensitive to the smell of tea tree oil I would definitely avoid this as it's very pungent. But it's performance and the results are golden. Smooth, glowing skin.

I absolutely adore this product. I don't use it on my face I use it on the rough parts of my body like my feet, knees, back of my arms, elbows, sometimes my back or my legs if I'm getting too much sun and they feel dry. The smell is so invigorating and pleasant but also calming. Scrubbing my body with this is such a great way to start the day. Makes me feel smooth, feel clean and smell good. It suds up so nicely. Really good stuff and will absolutely make a great gift to anyone who is not offended by the smell of tee tree oil.
